description.value: Panago is a Canadian pizza chain that prides itself on using fresh in-house dough made from 100% Canadian wheat, organic tomato sauce, and meats raised without antibiotics. The Chilliwack location on South Fraser Way offers delivery and takeout. Touring cyclists passing through Chilliwack could use it as a hot-meal stop, though it is a strip-mall franchise unit with no confirmed cyclist-specific amenities.
